subject: Pilot pricing sanity check + trial extension request
messages:
From: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.ai>
To: Alexa Torres <alexa.torres@brightpath.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-07-19T15:03:00-07:00
Subject: Pilot pricing sanity check + trial extension request

Hi Alexa — great to meet earlier. Quick recap from our discovery and the pricing items we flagged that need alignment before we spin up a production-like pilot:

- Expected token profile: 1.2M tokens/day (peak 2.0M) over a 6-week pilot.
- Primary workload: short-form single-turn generation (avg. 80 tokens/req), secondary reranking queries (avg. 40 tokens).
- Target economics you called out: ~$850 / 1M tokens as a target for planning (we noted you’re hoping for sub-$1k).
- Budget range you signaled: $35k–$60k for pilot run (including onboarding & credits).

Next steps I propose:
1) We provision a dedicated pilot environment and enable prefix caching for the top 10k prompts.
2) Redwood to provide an initial credit package to cover ~3 weeks of expected baseline run-rate while BrightPath validates quality and latency.
3) Procurement contact (procurement@brightpath.com) to confirm PO window if we look to extend beyond pilot.
4) Quick alignment call early next week to lock the $/1M target and batching assumptions.

I attached a lightweight pilot plan and assumptions (redwood-pilot-plan.pdf). Can you confirm the token numbers above and whether the $850 / 1M target is a firm gating metric?

Thanks,
Connor
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Mobile: +1 (415) 555-0183
From: Alexa Torres <alexa.torres@brightpath.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@brightpath.com
Date: 2028-07-20T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot pricing sanity check + trial extension request

Thanks Connor — quick answers inline.

- Token numbers: confirmed. Our load testing team ran a synthetic workload that maps to ~1.2M tokens/day sustained. We expect spikes up to 2M during catalog refresh cycles.
- Budget: $35k is the floor; if we need to extend the pilot to fully validate the retraining loop we can stretch to ~$55–60k but that requires more runway.
- $/1M target: Alexa here — $850 is the ideal target. If we get to ~$950 we can still justify, but anything north of $1,100 will likely kill the economics for this use case.

Procurement: looping them in here. They’ll need a short SOW and an invoice schedule to sign off.

On the credit ask — we’d like a safety buffer (30% extra credits) in case initial assumptions underpredict token churn. Can Redwood do a one-time credit top-up if we exceed baseline during the pilot?

Thanks,
Alexa
Director of AI Products | BrightPath Analytics
--
On Fri, Jul 19, 2028 at 3:03 PM Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Hi Alexa — great to meet earlier. Quick recap from our discovery and the pricing items we flagged...
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Alexa Torres <alexa.torres@brightpath.com>, procurement@brightpath.com
Date: 2028-07-21T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot pricing sanity check + trial extension request

Connor — I reviewed the numbers and the risk profile. We can approve a one-time 30% credit top-up over the originally quoted pilot allowance, contingent on the following:

- BrightPath agrees to a 6-week pilot window with a single extension request evaluated after week 4.
- Redwood retains the right to throttle non-production bursts that look anomalous; we'll work with your team on sane rate-limits.
- We’ll provide a short SOW + invoice schedule; Marissa will draft the paperwork.

I’ve attached the internal approval PDF (trial-credit-approval.pdf) and a DocuSign link for the SOW: https://docusign.com/smallflow/abc123

Note on unit economics: our estimate to hit ~$850 / 1M assumes batching improvements (avg batch size 8) and prefix/KV caching for 20% of requests. If BrightPath can run with those optimizations we should be fine.

—Ben
Head of Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
From: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.ai>
To: Alexa Torres <alexa.torres@brightpath.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, procurement@brightpath.com
Date: 2028-07-22T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot pricing sanity check + trial extension request

Alexa / team — thanks for the quick responses and thanks Ben for the approval. Finalizing next steps here so everyone has the same expectations: 

1) Redwood will provision the pilot cluster on Mon 7/24 with the initial credit pack (baseline) and an on-demand 30% top-up reserved should BrightPath exceed baseline during weeks 1–3.
2) Marissa will send the SOW and invoice schedule today; procurement can countersign via the DocuSign link Ben shared.
3) Engineering kickoff scheduled for Tue 7/25 @ 10am PT — expected attendees: BrightPath eng, Redwood SRE, and our SE (Marissa).
4) Check-in cadence: weekly syncs (Thursdays) and a mid-pilot review at week 3 to evaluate extension.

I’ve uploaded the mutual action plan and pilot assumptions here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB-Pilot-MAP (access granted to alexa.torres@brightpath.com).

If that all looks good I’ll mark the deal in HubSpot as Pilot:Commit and schedule the kickoff.

Connor
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
